description:
In `fsharp_mapper.ml`, the `walk_type` function for `type_app` nodes only keeps the base type and discards type arguments. For `List<int>`, only `List` is kept; `int` is lost.

Fix: Change `type_app` handling to produce `TApp(base_type, [arg_types])` or similar. The `typ` type in `types.ml` may need a new constructor `TApp of typ * typ list` to represent type application.

This is LOW priority — taint analysis doesn't currently use type arguments, but it's needed for future type-aware rules.
title: F# mapper: walk_type discards type arguments from type_app
